lede.zh: 在 8 张昇腾 950DT 卡上，以 8 个独立 TP1 服务实例测试 Qwen3.8-27B W8A8-MXFP8。覆盖文本、业务轨迹、长上下文、视觉、开放环请求和多轮 Agent 回放。
lede.en: Qwen3.8-27B W8A8-MXFP8 was tested on eight Ascend 950DT accelerators as eight independent TP1 serving instances. Workloads include text, business traces, long context, vision, open-loop arrivals, and multi-turn Agent replay.

snapshot.zh: 正式性能计划 51/51　/　Agent 回放 437/437　/　0 请求错误
snapshot.en: Formal performance plan 51/51　/　Agent replay 437/437　/　0 request errors

stats.zhNote: 提示长度 · C1 · 32 请求

heading.zh: 每个指标都保留它的场景
heading.en: Keep every metric attached to its workload

intro.zh: 这些结果来自八个独立单卡服务。服务在测量过程中逐步停止，不同测点的同机共跑条件并不完全相同；这里不把它们描述为固定八路干扰下的统一容量曲线。
intro.en: Results come from eight independent single-card services. Services were stopped as measurements completed, so co-run conditions differed between points; these are not a single capacity curve under a fixed eight-way interference pattern.

note.zh: 三轮测试点展示各轮统计值的中位数，而不是合并请求后重新计算的分位数。未定义业务 SLO，不标记“达标”或“最佳并发”。
note.en: For three-round points, the report shows the median of the per-round statistics, not percentiles recalculated from pooled requests. No business SLO was defined, so no point is labeled as passing or optimal.

label.zh: 文本、业务与长上下文负载

heading.zh: 固定请求规格下的多场景测量
heading.en: Multi-scenario measurements under controlled request sizes

intro.zh: 下表保留场景、请求数、实际 token 长度与延迟分位数。开放环到达率单独标注；闭环吞吐不代表开放环服务率。
intro.en: The table keeps scenario, request counts, observed token lengths, and latency percentiles together. Open-loop arrival rates are labeled separately; closed-loop throughput does not imply open-loop service rate.

title.zh: 8K / 512：独立服务实例中的观测吞吐

hint.zh: 各并发点来自不同 TP1 实例；不构成单实例并发曲线
hint.en: Concurrency points came from separate TP1 instances; they are not a single-instance scaling curve

zh: 场景 / 输入输出 tokens
实际输入 / 输出均值

notes.zh: TTOT-like 为每请求平均 token 间隔的统计值，不是逐 token 延迟分位数。样本少于 128 的场景按计划仅报告 P50；长上下文 32 请求点只测一轮。
notes.en: TPOT-like is a statistic over per-request average token intervals, not a per-token latency percentile. Scenarios with fewer than 128 requests report P50 only as planned; 32-request long-context points were run once.

notes.zh: 开放环只覆盖 λ=0.1 和 λ=0.05 req/s 两档，每轮 128 个请求，低于原计划的 512 请求容量扫描样本数。因此这里只报告这两个固定到达率的测量结果，不推断最大容量。
notes.en: The open-loop measurements cover only λ=0.1 and λ=0.05 req/s, with 128 requests per round, below the planned 512-request capacity scan. They are reported as measurements at these arrival rates, not as maximum capacity.

notes.zh: 图中的 C4、C8、C16、C32 来自不同独立服务实例，且各点的同机共跑负载不同。图表用于列出观测值，不应解读为单实例随并发扩展的曲线。
notes.en: C4, C8, C16, and C32 were measured on separate independent service instances, with different co-run loads. The chart lists observations and should not be read as a single-instance concurrency scaling curve.

heading.zh: 437 轮请求完成，测量的是服务回放
heading.en: 437 turns completed in a serving replay

intro.zh: 修复后的正式批次使用 16 个会话，回放冻结轨迹中的工具观察，不实际执行外部工具。该结果描述推理服务，不代表 Agent 任务成功率。
intro.en: The corrected formal run used 16 sessions and replayed tool observations from frozen traces without executing external tools. It describes inference serving and is not an Agent task-success rate.

hint.zh: 單一测量点，不用于比较其他模型或权重
hint.en: Single measured point; not a comparison against other models or weights

zh: 平均输入 / 输出 tokens

notes.zh: 16 个会话是独立会话样本；437 轮请求不是 437 个独立会话，不据此报告会话级 P95/P99。正式批次关闭服务端自动工具调用解析器以修复协议问题；早期 435/437 的失败批次不纳入正式结果。
notes.en: The independent sample is 16 sessions; 437 request turns are not 437 independent sessions, so no session-level P95/P99 is reported. The formal run disabled server-side automatic tool-call parsing to resolve a protocol issue; the earlier 435/437 run is excluded.

intro.zh: 该测试用于补充报告任务质量边界，与吞吐测试分开解释。每题只测一次，使用固定采样参数并按 A/B/C/D 精确匹配。
intro.en: This evaluation supplements the serving results with a task-quality boundary and is interpreted separately from throughput. Each question was run once with fixed sampling parameters and exact A/B/C/D matching.

notes.zh: 该分数受 16K 输出上限影响：37.37% 的题目达到上限且未抽取到答案并按规则计错。不能将其直接解释为无上限推理能力，也不应只按未截断题计算准确率。
notes.en: This score is affected by the 16K output cap: 37.37% of questions reached the cap without an extracted answer and were scored incorrect. It does not directly represent uncapped reasoning ability; accuracy should not be recalculated using only uncapped questions.

notes.zh: 三个非权重文件与模型目录的 CRC 记录不符，因此报告不将该分数与模型卡分数直接对照。
notes.en: Three non-weight files did not match the model directory CRC record, so this report does not compare the score directly with the model card.

methodIntro.zh: 采用多实例 TP1 部署；正式场景按冻结计划执行。对重复波动、样本规模与工具协议变更作明确说明。
methodIntro.en: The setup uses multiple TP1 instances and follows the frozen scenario plans. Repeat variability, sample sizes, and the tool-protocol change are documented explicitly.

value.zh: 8 个独立 TP1 服务实例；不是 TP8
未收录地址、主机名、凭据、原始请求或本地路径
value.en: Addresses, hostnames, credentials, raw requests and local paths excluded

methodNotes.zh: 测点的同机共跑负载随服务逐步停止而变化。三个启动轮次的噪声审查显示：TTFT P50 最大相对极差为 28.93%，20 点中 2 点超过 10%；TPOT-like P50 最大 5.10%，E2E P50 最大 7.97%。因此业务 TTFT 的小幅差异不宜过度解读。
methodNotes.en: Co-run load changed as services were stopped. Across three startup rounds, the maximum relative range for TTFT P50 was 28.93%, with 2 of 20 points above 10%; TPOT-like P50 max range was 5.10%, and E2E P50 max range was 7.97%. Small business TTFT differences should not be overinterpreted.

methodNotes.zh: 本页发布的是整理后的聚合结果，不包含原始请求轨迹、逐题回答、机器地址、集群名、路径、凭据或运行日志。对外发布前已移除具体设备槽位编号。
methodNotes.en: This page publishes curated aggregates only. It excludes raw request traces, per-question responses, host addresses, cluster names, paths, credentials, and run logs. Specific device-slot identifiers are omitted.
